snippet.title: SCAVENGER ZERO Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3168670/SCAVENGER_ZERO/

About time I made an updated trailer for SCAVENGER ZERO, as a lot has changed with the game since the last one. I plan on releasing a demo for Steam NextFest on June 15th.


I also finally made a PRESS KIT. It's barebones right now, I'll add some more stuff to it later.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1c_badbXv54rBNS1yAuMYY9KvibTJHE9V?usp=sharing
